data.action: 打烊后淋浴，疲惫地靠着瓷砖墙
data.description: 女仆咖啡店打烊后，白夜拖着疲惫的身体走进狭小的员工淋浴间。热水冲下来的一瞬间，她长长地舒了口气，靠着瓷砖墙仰起头，水珠顺着银白的发丝滑落。她小声嘟囔着——「……今天的营业额，够交这个月房租了……明天也要加油。」
data.lighting: dim fluorescent light, cascading water, soft steam haze
data.location: 女仆咖啡店员工淋浴间
data.promptProse: Adult Byakuya leans against the shower tiles, towel secured around her, face tilted up beneath the water. A dim fluorescent lamp catches droplets in the steam.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 女仆店打烊后的员工淋浴
data.animaCaption: The towel stays secured around her beneath the shower water.
